scope: PlanarSrf retains crossing sibling hole loops and their model-area contributions; a constrained mesh arrangement excludes their geometric union, preserves normal channels and survives 3DM serialization.

native_area_gap.geometry: Complete positive boundary bases in each build, and native spatial/affinely lifted UV control definitions checked at 1e-12. Local analytic area checked at 1e-15.
native_area_gap.history: The primary and application comparisons require exactly two occurrences (after/redo); archive comparison requires exactly one. Every other area mismatch fails.
native_area_gap.diagnostics: The 33 holdouts repeat twice with byte-for-byte unchanged original B-rep definitions. Translation and unit-domain reparameterization preserve this scalar discrepancy. Unit-domain copies retain identical spatial controls and topology, and their UV control charts are independently checked.

comparisons.sources: Complete NURBS source definitions at 1e-12 in the public homogeneous getter chart; retained Rust source objects checked for exact equality.
comparisons.regions: Original outer/inner boundary membership, counts and multiplicity; output and inner-loop order canonicalized.
comparisons.area: Pilot 1e-5 absolute; precise 1e-9 absolute plus 1e-12 relative; legacy six cases 1e-10 absolute. The single named scalar gap above is reported explicitly.
comparisons.membership: Bidirectional spatial witnesses at 1e-7, with complete positive-basis coefficient checks for the tiny-circle area discrepancy.
comparisons.meshes: Eight scenes compare 64 spatial coverage stations to native default render meshes at 1e-6; polygonal mesh area at 1e-9. Raw native mesh definitions retained.
comparisons.archive: Persistent UUID lookup, output region comparison and audited normal-mesh generation before and after output 3DM round trips.
comparisons.excluded: Full native B-rep parameterization and output birth order are not primary comparison gates. Native face-membership metadata is preserved separately from mesh coverage.

architecture: Planar face construction extracted from brep.rs. The ordinary disjoint-hole constructor retains its validation; an explicit overlapping-hole constructor admits each hole independently. Native builds retain usd-brep profile admission and construction with exact fallback.

headless.native_captures: Private Xvfb/i3/runtime directory through tools/rhino_oracle/run_headless.sh; Wayland/compositor sockets unset; only owned Rhino closed.
headless.application_tests: test_app state with desktop display/compositor variables removed; no GUI event loop.

limits: One tiny-circle native area-reporting discrepancy remains explicit; full scalar parity is not claimed.
Curved mesh intersections use sampled chords; continuous curve-error bounds, native triangulation topology, arbitrary self-intersections and comparative performance remain unqualified.
Native face-membership diagnostics differ from native mesh coverage at some crossing-hole stations; face-membership API parity is not established.
Original full used B-rep definitions are retained; complete native parameterization and ordering are not qualified.
The fallback retains the 131072-vertex limit and bounds constraint traversal/recovery to four million steps. Thin facets use exact binary64-coordinate determinants when floating area is uncertain.
